problem_statement: Claude Code and other Anthropic-SDK clients are hardwired to the Anthropic API surface, but developers often need to route to Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Gemini, or self-hosted models without rewriting tooling. A drop-in Anthropic-compatible gateway is required.

personas.name: Enterprise Claude Code Developer
personas.pain: Claude Code speaks only to api.anthropic.com

positioning: For Claude Code users needing backend flexibility, CCP is a local Anthropic-API-compatible gateway routing to Azure/OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic via LiteLLM, preserving streaming, tool-use and multi-modal while pinning LiteLLM to a safe range.

functional: Route Anthropic requests to any backend

market_size.value: Internal single-user tool; ~10k Claude Code users globally would benefit

hypotheses.statement: Tier-name remapping gives stable mental model
Menu bar app lowers switching cost
